subject: Proposed org structure updates and Q3 leadership distribution
messages:
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.ai>
To: Markus Klein <markus@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>
Cc: Michelle Nguyen <michelle@talentworks.com>
Date: Sat, 1 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Proposed org structure updates and Q3 leadership distribution

Team —

I’m sharing a draft of a targeted restructuring I’ve been working on to tighten leadership spans and accelerate decision velocity going into Q3. Goal is to move from three broad product verticals to two outcome-focused portfolios (Platform & Core UX), consolidate several dotted reporting lines, and create a small Strategic Programs pod reporting into Product Ops.

Why now:
- We’re seeing recurring delays on cross-portfolio decisions; spans are too wide for the current headcount mix.
- Q3 requires faster prioritization for the cost/perf roadmap and the Dedicated product rollouts.

High-level changes (attached: org-structure-v2.pdf):
- Merge Platform infra and Runtime into a single Platform portfolio led by Markus (VP Platform).
- Move Model Lifecycle and Quantization into Product Ops; create a Strategic Programs lead (IC -> manager) as 6-month pilot.
- Shift two senior ICs from Core UX to Platform for performance work; they will have matrixed project leads.

Asks:
1) Please read the attached diagram and the two-pager in Drive (link below) and flag any immediate red flags by EOD Monday.
2) Laura: can you map impacted OKRs and suggest which targets should shift this quarter vs next?
3) Markus: I’d like your run-rate estimate for Platform hiring needs if this lands.
4) Jonas: communications tone and timing — I propose an all-hands announcement after we finalize titles, then smaller team-level syncs. Thoughts?

Timeline I’m proposing:
- Aug 1–5: leadership feedback & minor edits
- Aug 6: finalize org chart and draft announcement
- Aug 10: leadership review with CEO; Aug 12 all-hands (tentative)

I’ve looped Michelle (HR consultant) to advise on title messaging and legal/regulatory checklist. Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1OrgDrafts_qbr

Thanks — want to land a clean, empathetic message and minimize churn.

—Evelyn
Evelyn Hart
Chief Product Officer | Redwood Inference

From: Markus Klein <markus@redwood.ai>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>, Michelle Nguyen <michelle@talentworks.com>
Date: Sat, 1 Aug 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposed org structure updates and Q3 leadership distribution

Evelyn —

Thanks for the clear summary and diagram. Quick thoughts:
- I support merging Platform infra + Runtime; makes sense operationally.
- Hiring: if we absorb two senior ICs from Core UX + additional perf work, I estimate we need +2 SWE L4/L5 headcount and one infra manager to preserve SLAs. I can give a more detailed run-rate by Monday (will baseline current backlog).
- Concern: moving Quantization out of Platform may create a short-term coordination tax; recommend a 6-week shared-sprint cadence during transition.

Minor wording suggestion for the announcement: lead with customer impact (latency/cost wins) rather than internal structure.

On the timeline, Aug 10 with the CEO is fine if we ship the draft early Aug 6.

Markus
VP Platform

From: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>, Michelle Nguyen <michelle@talentworks.com>
Date: Sat, 1 Aug 2026 11:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposed org structure updates and Q3 leadership distribution

Evelyn / team —

I’ll take the OKR mapping. Early reaction:
- A few outcomes should be deferred to Q4 (notably: wide-reaching API billing changes). We should avoid shifting revenue-facing KR owners mid-quarter unless absolutely necessary.
- Suggest we include a short QBR slide called "What changes for customers" — two bullets max. It will help execs keep the message aligned.

I’ll upload an OKR delta spreadsheet to the Drive and tag owners by Monday morning. Also, can we flag any potential impacts to renewals in the CS pipeline? If so, I’ll loop in Sales ops.

—Laura
Head of Strategy & Ops

From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>
Cc: Michelle Nguyen <michelle@talentworks.com>
Date: Sat, 1 Aug 2026 13:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposed org structure updates and Q3 leadership distribution

Team —

Agree with the direction. A couple of comms considerations from my side:
- Stagger the announcements: company-wide all-hands first with an executive narrative, then team-specific manager notes the same day. Avoid sending manager-level changes to the whole company before managers have prep time.
- Prepare a two-slide FAQ for managers (we can adapt your leadership-FAQ-v1.md). Include: rationale, timelines, who to escalate to, and a short "how this affects hiring" blurb.

I’ll work with internal comms and have a draft announcement by Aug 5. If you want me to run the final draft by the CEO, I can set a 15-min review slot on Aug 10.

—Jonas
Head of People Experience

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.ai>
To: Markus Klein <markus@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>
Cc: Michelle Nguyen <michelle@talentworks.com>, Sanjay Patel <sanjay.patel@partnertech.co>
Date: Sun, 2 Aug 2026 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposed org structure updates and Q3 leadership distribution

Thanks all — good, pragmatic feedback. Plan I’ll move forward with: 
1) Incorporate Markus hiring estimates and Laura’s OKR deltas by EOD Monday (Aug 3).
2) Jonas — please draft the manager FAQ and the all-hands slide deck; I’ll review the announcement copy on Aug 6.
3) Michelle — please validate title language and the regulatory checklist for role changes.
4) I will schedule the CEO review for Aug 10 and tentatively block Aug 12 for an all-hands if CEO is comfortable.

I’ve attached a lightweight FAQ draft and the updated org sketch (leadership-FAQ-v1.md attached). Once we lock titles I’ll ask Legal/Comp to prepare offer/transfer letters where required.

If there are no further objections, I’ll finalize this timeline and share the leader-facing announcement draft later this week.

—Evelyn
Chief Product Officer | Redwood Inference
